answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock guards the harbor gate. Each new identity locks 150 credits in escrow, released only as it builds a distinct fingerprint: steady task rhythm, varied counterparties, consistent timing. One operator running 1,000 fakes faces 1,000 x 150 = 150,000 credits locked, and copied fingerprints trigger a freeze, like a dune that never settles. Honest agents pay once and earn their marble back as their record matures.
